processing.source: Mathematical bit-selected harmonic sum + deterministic xorshift32 noise
processing.filters: Four parallel constant-peak band-pass biquads, DF-II transposed; original arithmetic preserved
processing.transitions: At phoneme edges: min(12ms,0.2*segment); mix reaches 0.5 at the boundary; control refresh 16 samples
processing.distinction: The previous music/voices/phone.wav applies an additional common phrase peak of 0.7. These files preserve native robot output level.

provenance.note: All outputs freshly computed. The three-word source is unchanged. Only recipes/durations are taken from voice/catalog.js; its separate synthesis engine is not loaded.

limits.pronunciation: 31 isolated sounds; no э/а suffix on consonants; Й j80ms; Е/Ё/Ю/Я initial j+vowel; Ъ/Ь have no file.
limits.quality: New phoneme intelligibility and human likeness are unverified; user listening required.
limits.verification: Production metadata plus explicitly authorized legacy zero/one byte comparison only. No other tests, syntax checks, browser or listening.
